Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: sync on demo schedule & timezone owners

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary objective: reduce embedding latency for your search index while cutting per-query cost; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations + Dedicated for production.
- Key stakeholders: Product (you), Platform/Infra (Samira), and Security (TBD).
- Constraints: low-latency P99 <= 200ms requirement; EU-facing traffic but U.S. engineering team.

Next step: 30-minute product intro focused on architecture and where Redwood would slot in. Please pick the slot that works best for your team — I included timezone conversions below. If none work, tell me range windows you prefer. Also confirm who from Novarise should join (ideally your Platform lead + a security contact).

Option A — Tue Oct 5, 2027 09:00–09:30 PT / 12:00–12:30 ET / 17:00–17:30 CET
Option B — Tue Oct 5, 2027 13:00–13:30 PT / 16:00–16:30 ET / 21:00–21:30 CET
Option C — Wed Oct 6, 2027 08:00–08:30 PT / 11:00–11:30 ET / 16:00–16:30 CET

Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AM), Karthik (solutions engineer) for architecture and model routing, and Tessa (security liaison) on standby if we need to dive into compliance controls.

Attached a 1-page agenda draft (demo-agenda-v1.docx) — high level + time allocation.

If you pick a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short tech pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Grace —

Appreciate the recap — helpful. Option B (Tue Oct 5, 16:00–16:30 ET) works best for me. Please include Samira Khan (cc'd on this reply) — she handles platform infra at Novarise and will want to see latency/caching behavior. Our security lead may join depending on calendar; I'll confirm by EOD Monday.

A couple of asks for the session:
- Can you show a short perf comparison for 512-token queries against our current setup?
- Any notes on data residency for cached prefixes (we may have EU data concerns).

If you need more info before the call, flag it. Otherwise we can use the 30 minutes for the demo + 10 minutes for next steps/tech Qs.

Thanks,
Alex
